name: How To Print In Java
html:
Welcome to the amazing coding journey with pepcoding. So, are you ready to explore the world of programming and learn a lot of interesting algorithmic problems and explore many data structures? So, let's start with our very first program in Java language.


Important Links :Question Video

Problem Discussion :

Dear reader, today we will learn how we can print something on the screen in Java programming language. So, first let us understand what we are supposed to do. Currently, you are viewing our website and you are reading this article. What do you see? You see some texts and images etc. written already on the screen, right? The same way, when a user runs a program developed by a developer (or coder), the coder wants something to be already visible on the screen.

So, that's what we are going to learn today. When someone runs a java code, we want some text (any text of our choice) to be visible to them in the output window. For instance, have a look at the image shown below:

For more clarity of the question, watch the question video.

Watch video

So, when we run the Java program, we see a text "Hello!!" written on the output window.

Approach :

So, dear reader, the code below shows how to print "hello world" in Java.

The statement System.out.println("Hello World") prints "Hello World".

Now, let us try something else with this code. Seems that the sentence that we have written inside the commas " " is getting printed. So, let us try to print Pepcoding now and see if we are correct about our judgement or not.

Output:

So, yes, we are correct!! Whatever we have inside the commas is getting printed. This is the syntax to print anything on the screen using Java. We recommend you try this out yourself once. Try to print your name or your friend's name.

Also, dear reader, please note that you have to keep certain things abstract for now. What do we mean by this? Have a look at the image shown below:

We have not told you what do all these lines mean. We will study about all of this in detail when we will move forward with the course. It is just like you learnt the alphabets in English. You didn't ask that why this "A" is A or like mathematics that you just learnt 2+2=4 but you didn't know the reason.

We will learn all the other things in the program latter. For now, you just need to know that to print in Java, we write System.out.println("") and within the quotes we will write whatever we want to print on our screen.

Difference Between print and println

Have a look at the code given below:

import java.util.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { System.out.println("Pepcoding"); System.out.println("Educates"); } }
java; true";

The output for the above code is:

In this code, we have used the function println which says that after printing the content inside the commas, we have to leave a line and hance we get "Pepcoding" and "Educates" in different lines. Have a look at the code shown below:

import java.util.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { System.out.print("Pepcoding"); System.out.print("Educates"); } }
java; true";

The output for this code is:

So, we can now see the difference between these two functions. What are functions? Again, let these things remain abstract for now. You just need to know for now that if we write println, a line will be left and if we write print, it will not be left.

We can leave a line also using "print" by using a special character " ". Look at the code shown below:

Output for the code:

The character " " is equivalent of hitting the "ENTER" key on the keyboard. So, dear reader, we hope that you have understood the complete difference between both type of printing methods.
